scope: From the seat of the dog owner: whether my dog is a dangerous dog (s 3, r 4); whether I must register it (s 7(1), (3)) and the most I can be fined ($5 000 / $10 000; modified penalty $200 / $400, r 33); whether the local government must or may refuse registration (s 16(3), (3A)); the registration fee with the sterilised, pensioner, 3-year, lifetime, stock-dog, half-year, assistance-dog and local-discount rules and the dangerous-dog exclusions (s 15, rr 17, 18, 20); when the registration ends (s 15(2), (3A)); the refund on later sterilisation (r 19); the microchipping duty, the vet-certificate exemption, the s 22(3) period and the fines (ss 21, 22); the s 23 microchip notice; lawful control in public places, leash length and exercise and rural areas (ss 31, 32, r 27); the collar and tag (s 30); dangerous dog declarations, the 7-day objection deadline and when a declaration takes effect (ss 33E, 33F). Dangerous dog control (s 33GA-33M), attacks (s 33D), transfers, kennels, greyhounds, nuisance, pet shops and machinery out.
